svg.title: Three-Gene Homework Tetrad Table
svg.desc: Original BPW homework table, all three genes visible in four labeled spore boxes. Given parents: a++ / +bc. Total 1200 tetrads. Set 1: +++, +++, abc, abc; 2 tetrads; Set 2: ++c, ++c, ab+, ab+; 5 tetrads; Set 3: ++c, +bc, a++, ab+; 198 tetrads; Set 4: +b+, +b+, a+c, a+c; 11 tetrads; Set 5: +b+, +bc, a++, a+c; 282 tetrads; Set 6: +bc, +bc, a++, a++; 702 tetrads Gold outline: Set 6, 702 tetrads, contains only the original parental genotypes a++ and +bc, so it is PD for every pair. Classify using genotypes, not frequency.
